mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN status BETWEEN 10 AND 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testing_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS judged_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qualified_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unqualified_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN conclusion = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_samples, SUM(CASE WHEN report_generated_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS report_count FROM sample_info WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT CAST(status AS CHAR) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sample_info WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(inspect_type), ''), '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sample_info WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(inspect_type), ''), '未分类') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(client_name), ''), '未填写') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sample_info WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(client_name), ''), '未填写') ORDER BY value DESC, name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.category), ''), '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sample_item i JOIN sample_info s ON s.id = i.sample_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_lib_item li ON li.id = i.lib_item_id AND li.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_lib p ON p.id = li.product_lib_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.category), ''), '未分类') ORDER BY value DESC, name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.tester_no), ''), '未指派') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sample_item i JOIN sample_info s ON s.id = i.sample_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND s.status >= 40 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.tester_no), ''), '未指派') ORDER BY value DESC, name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.dept_name), ''), '未分配') AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS value FROM sample_info s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = s.created_by AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.dept_name), ''), '未分配') ORDER BY value DESC, name

SELECT i.item_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sample_result r JOIN sample_item i ON i.id = r.sample_item_id AND i.deleted = 0 JOIN sample_info s ON s.id = i.sample_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.conclusion = 2 AND i.is_reference = 0 GROUP BY i.item_name ORDER BY value DESC, name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS sample_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status >= 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count FROM sample_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL (#{months} - 1) MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month
